title: GDScript parser segfaults and crashes on very long expressions
body: ### Tested versions - Reproducible on master [6d6e822c6] and 4.6.2 [001aa128b] ### System information Linux ### Issue description I made a really long expression ```gdscript static func my_func() -> void: var i := 0 i += i - i + i + i - i + i + i - i + # it goes on like this for a long time ``` Upon trying to run this, I hit this error: ``` Process 3529170 stopped * thread #1, name = 'godot.linuxbsd.', stop reason = signal SIGSEGV: address not mapped to object (fault address=0x7ffffe1fe0c0) frame #0: 0x0000555558a6a761 godot.linuxbsd.editor.dev.x86_64.llvm.san`GDScriptCompiler::_parse_expression(this=0x00007bfff6040e40, codegen=0x00007bfff6062020, r_error=0x00007bfff6064020, p_expression=0x00007d2ff722d350, p_root=false, p_initializer=false) at gdscript_compiler.cpp:254 251 return true; 252 } 253 -> 254 GDScriptCodeGenerator::Address GDScriptCompiler::_parse_expression(CodeGen &codegen, Error &r_error, const GDScriptParser::ExpressionNode *p_expression, bool p_root, bool p_initializer) { 255 if (p_expression->is_constant && !(p_expression->get_datatype().is_meta_type && p_expression->get_datatype().kind == GDScriptParser::DataType::CLASS)) { 256 return codegen.add_constant(p_expression->reduced_value); 257 } ``` ### Steps to reproduce Just make a really, really long expression (mine was a flat list of about 4000 additions and subtractions), then try to compile it. ### Minimal reproduction project (MRP) This file contains a single script that you can run with `godot --script --headless --quit` [main.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/27071218/main.zip)
